dct_description_sm: This study tackled the challenge of improving the protein feeding value of sunflower meal, a lower-cost and more sustainable alternative protein ingredient, by determining how processing method and gastric pH influence protein structure and nitrogen solubility. Although sunflower meal has potential as a soybean meal alternative, its nutritive value can be limited by lower protein concentration, fiber content, and processing-induced changes in protein structure that may reduce protein accessibility during digestion.
dct_title_s: Cold-pressing sunflower meal and gastric pH synergistically improve in vitro nitrogen solubility by preserving secondary protein structure, outperforming soybean meal, solvent-extracted sunflower meal, and high-protein electrostatically separated sunflower
